verdict.rationale: Cloudflare ships Wrangler, its own first-party command-line tool for building Workers. The docs cover commands to create, develop, deploy, roll back and manage resources such as D1, and the probe confirms the official CLI documentation; community discussion also references Wrangler. missing for 10: evidence of agent-oriented CLI features (machine-readable/JSON output, non-interactive token auth for agents), independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use in AI-agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: A command line tool for building [Cloudflare Workers](https://workers.cloudflare.com/).
The core Wrangler commands for creating, developing, and deploying Workers are on the Workers commands page.
To roll back to a specified version of your Worker via Wrangler, use the [`wrangler rollback`](/workers/wrangler/commands/general/#rollback) command.
